event_id.description: The unique identifier for the event.

condition.description: The condition under which the event will be held (e.g., Indoor, Outdoor).

activities.description: A list of activities planned for the event.

attendance.description: The attendance requirement for the event (e.g., voluntary, mandatory).

announcements.description: Any announcements related to the event.

start_time.description: The start time of the event.

end_time.description: The end time of the event.

calendar_id.description: The ID of the calendar associated with the event.

user_id.description: The ID of the user who created or is associated with the event.

e_token.description: A unique token associated with the event.
